verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions a free tier, a trial, or any no-cost plan that permits real sends. The only related item is Sandbox Mode, which validates requests without delivering email. That is a dry-run, not a plan allowing real deliveries to users, so it earns no credit. The other pricing reference only says EU regional sending requires the Pro plan or above.

support.subject: As a founder, I can integrate and validate the service on a free tier or trial that allows real deliveries to my own users, not just a demo
